capabilities: Edit notes collaboratively in real time with visible cursors
Sync changes to collaborators while Obsidian is open
Encrypt shared notes and blobs end-to-end
Self-host the collaboration server or subscribe to the hosted service
extras: Currently installed via BRAT pending Obsidian community approval. Hosted mode has no free tier ($9/user/month, 3GB storage cap, 25MB blob limit); self-hosted mode is free. README warns of beta-stage bugs and data-loss risks and recommends keeping backups. Server code lives in a separate sister monorepo.
intentEvidence: Everything you love about Google Docs, but in your lovely local Obsidian instance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share folders with other people and edit notes together in real time with live cursors.

relations.evidence: Everything you love about Google Docs, but in your lovely local Obsidian instance.

requires.name: $9 USD per subscribed user per month for hosted mode

summary: Real-time collaborative editing plugin that shares vault folders and notes with end-to-end encryption, via a hosted service or self-hosted server.
